description: Scrape a single web page from a cloud browser and return clean content (markdown, html, links, and page metadata). Handles JS-rendered pages. Example: hyperbrowser_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Hyperbrowser API key. Sign up at https://app.hyperbrowser.ai (docs: https://docs.hyperbrowser.ai/).

formats.description: Output formats to include. Any of "markdown", "html", "links". Default ["markdown"].

onlyMainContent.description: If true, strip nav/footer/ads and return only the main article content. Default true.

url.description: The full URL to scrape, e.g. "https://example.com/page"

name: hyperbrowser_scrape
title: Hyperbrowser Scrape
